notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Changed the Monk's Meditate ability to also grant 2 AP each time it heals, rewarding longer Meditates.
[*]Fixed a bug with the Archmage that allowed the use of Ritual: Ward before the ability was learned.
[*]Fixed a bug with the Archmage that allowed the use of UnleashArcana even when you had no missiles to unleash.
[*]Added a button to switch between Active and Wait battle modes when creating a new game. This is functionally equivalent to the setting in the options menu, but since that option was missed by many new players, I tried putting it somewhere more visible for first time players.
[*]Improved readability of various UI elements
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.01c -- More cosmetic improvements
notes.content:
- Added an overlay displaying the name of the zone and some flavor text when you change zones
- Improved visual acuity of in-battle menus; these also now fade slightly when an ability is unable to be used

notes.title: Patch 1.01b
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Redesigned "AggroLines" design (these show up when you target an enemy, or they target you)
[*] Fixed a few terrain issues in Cult of the Void
[*] Fixed some situations where the game could crash if it couldn't play a specific sound for some reason
[/list]

notes.title: 1.01 Post-launch Patch
notes.content:
Just a few quick fixes
- Fleshed out terrain for Cult of the Void
- Fixed some various graphical glitches
- Added a 'glow' effect to the leader (your first chosen character) to indicate which character you're actually controlling on the World screen. This can be disabled in the Options menu.
